msContents.summary: This manuscript, from the Limaye collection at the BORI, has never before been edited. It contains the complete text of the Vahnipurāṇa.

msItem.title: Vahnipurāṇa
msItem.rubric: śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || oṃ namaḥ śivāyoa namaḥ ||
msItem.incipit: tejomayāmanā|m anyonyam ekasmiṃ vividhātmanāṃ || bhede vibhinnatā pusāṃ trayāṇāṃm astu vaḥ śriye ||
msItem.finalRubric:
iti vahnipuraṇe ākhyānaśata
kīrttano nāmādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || || sampapram idaṃ puraṇam āgneyaṃ samāptaṃ ||

lg.l: śṛṇu rājan pravakṣyāmi svamāṃsaṃ śivinā yathā ||
svamāṃsaṃ dattavān_ satyaṃ purā hy ausīnareṇa vā |
satyadānarataṃ jñātvā śivim iṃdrāśuśukṣaṇī ||

jijñāsārthaṃ same yātāṃ vartta¦
māne mahādhvare ||
vahnir bhūtvā kapotas tu hariḥ śyenāt puraḥsaraṃ |
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavidvalaḥ |
trāhi māṃ pṛthivīpālety avadachenajād bhayāt |

sa tam āścāsayāsa kapo
taṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||
rājānam upagamyātha syenaḥ provāca saṃsadi |
vacanaṃ śṛṇu me rājaṃ kṣudhārtasya kuṭaṃbinaḥ |
dharmātmānaṃ tvam āhur vai pṛthivyāṃ sarvapārthivāḥ ||

tadviruddhaṃ kathaṃ karma kartum icha
si pārthiva ||
ghṛtaghnā bhavatā dānaiḥ sādhunā'|sādhavo jitāḥ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaḥ satyenānṛtavādinaḥ ||
sarāgā vītarāgeṇa tathā'kopena kopinaḥ |

satṛṣṇā vītatṛṣṇena tva
yāḥ lokāḥ parājitāḥ ||
sarvasya saṃpadaḥ svārthāḥ svaparārthās tu kasyacit |
parārthā bhavato nityaṃ saphalasya taror iva |
nopakārapare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |

apakārapare pi tvam upakāra
paraḥ sadā |
mamaiṣa vihito dhātrā bhakṣo yaṃ taṃ samutsṛje ||
svaṃ rakṣam ātmano dharmaṃ kṣudhitasyāa kapotakaṃ ||
sa śyenam āha saṃprāptas trāṇārthī saṃnidhau mama ||

khago ṣṭrasyāsmin kathaṃ kuryā tyāgaṃ sadbhi
r vigarhitaṃ ||
lobhād veṣāt_ bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsamaṃmaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niḥkṛtir ddṛṣṭvā mahāpātakinām api |

śaraṇāgatahātus tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛ
tiḥ | kvacit ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmā tyubhayatrastā rakṣitavyāḥ prayatnataḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair mmagnāḥ saṃsārasāgare ||

jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trastaṃ
tv ime tataḥ |
yannimittaṃ bhavechaukas trāsaḥ krodho bhayaṃ tathā ||
āyāso vāyaso mūlam ekāṃgam api taṃ tyajet ||
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

śakyaṃte nānumānena paro pi pari
kṣituṃ ||
yathā ca te jīvitam pratmanipriyaṃ tathā | pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ
saṃrakṣa me jīvita|m ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ ||

tasmāt tavāhaṃ na samarppayiṣye kapotakaṃ | na yad atra
yuktaṃ |
dhatvaṃ manyase tat karavāṇi sarvam ṛte kapotāt khalu satyam atra ||
bhavaṃti sarvvabhūtāni āhāreṇa janesvara |
jīvaṃti ca vivarddhaṃte āhāreṇa na saṃśayaḥ |

āhāraṃ duṣka
raṃ kurvan_ ciraṃ jīvati prāṇabhṛt |
na tv āhāravihīno pi śaknoti jīvitaṃ ciraṃ ||
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate ||
visṛjya kāyaṃ syāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ |

mṛte ma
yi nṛpaśreṣṭa putradārādikaṃ kulaṃ ||
vinasyati kathaṃ dharmo bhavitā te nṛponṛtama |
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa hi sadbhir ucyate ||

tasmād virodhe dharmasya
niściṃtya gurulāghavaṃ |
manyase gauravaṃ yatra tat kuruṣva nṛpottama |
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||

nāto gurudhata
ro dharman kaścid anyo sti khecara ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ abhayaṃ yat pradīyate ||
varam ekasya satvasya pradattaṃ jīvitābhayaṃ ||
na ca viprasahas tasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtāṃ |

hemadhenucarādīnāṃ dā
tāra sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarbabhūtābhayāmahaḥ |
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣayam eva na vidyate ||

abhayaṃ sarvasatvebhyo yo dadāti
dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasvya kṣayaṃ nāsti kutaścana ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutaṃ tathā ||
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃn nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśī |

catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtaṃ yo dadyāt pṛthi
vīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ yaśru bhūtebhyo yo dadāti tato dhikaḥ |
api tyaje rājyam ahaṃ śarīraṃ vāpi dustyajaṃ |
na tv enaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ |

janmano sti śubhaṃ kicit tena janmani ja¦
nmani ||
bhave trātā mahārtānām ārtināśāya dehināṃ |
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥskhanāśanaṃ |

yathā tv ananṛtāṃ vāṇīm aham etām udā
hare |
satyena tena bhagavan_ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ ||
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgamā |
tad yathaiva tavāhāraṃ manyase ta dadāmy ahaṃ ||
śyenaḥ | prāha mamāhāro na tv anyatra kapotakaṃ |

ta
tyaktā kāmaye nānyam āhāraṃ rājasattama ||
śyenā kapotakān_ ghnaṃti sthitir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha ||

rājāvocad amārgeṇa vartte nāhaṃ kva
cit khaga |
dharmmaśāstropadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ ||
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekabhūteṣu yā dayā ||
sarvasatvapradānāc ca dayaikātra viśiṣyate |
sarvavedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvaśāstrāṇi khecarā |

sa
rvatīrthābhiṣekaś cat kuryāt prāṇināṃ daya ||
vāṅmanaḥkarmatirthe tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te |
gachaṃs tiṣṭaṃ svapan_ jāgrad yo hitaṃ na samācaret |

narebhyaḥ
sa paśur jñeyaḥ ātmano py ahitaḥ sa vai |
duḥkhino duḥkhino vāpi prāṇino labdhacakṣuṣa |
na ātmavat paripaśyaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||

sa yā
ti narakaṃ ghoram iti hy āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
tulyaṃ hi sumahad rājyaṃ prayachāmi vihaṃgamaḥ |
yathā kāmayase vānyad varjayitvā kapotakāṃ |
śyenaḥ prāha kim etat te prītir āsīt khage dṛḍhā ||

kathaṃve
d asya tulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me ||
rājānam avravīd dhṛṣṭo yan me māṃsāni yācase ||
etad yachāmi te sadyaḥ svamāṃsaṃ tulayā dhṛtaṃ ||
yat pārthito smi bhodraṃ te prīyam etad vadāmi te |

satyadharmma
ratasyāpy asataḥ | sumahadapriyaṃ |
adhrudeṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā ||
dhruvaṃ yoe nārjayed dharmaṃ socyaṃ mūḍhacetana |
yadi prāyoprakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate |

tataḥ kim upacāro sya
pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||
evam uktāt svamāṃsāni kapotena samaṃ nṛpaḥ ||
utkṛtya tolayāmāsa prahṛṣṭo manasā taḥ |
tyaktātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo
nityaduḥkhitāḥ |
tulayā dhriyamāṇas tu kapoto tyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit ||

tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso pi sādhuḥ sukhaya
te paraṃ ||
dyadā tena na nulāṃ tat_ sa tulām āruhat svayaṃ |
aṃtaḥpuravasthīṣu na rājye na ca jīvite |
karuṇāsaktacittena tenāpekṣā kṛtā kvacit ||
paraduḥkhānuarā nityaṃ svasukhāni mahāṃty api |

nā
pekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ sarbabhūtahite ratāḥ |
parārtham udyatā saṃtaḥ saṃtaḥ kiṃ kiṃ na kurbate |
tādṛg apy aṃbudher vāri jaladais tat prapīyate ||
ekā eva satāṃ mārgo yad aṃgīkṛtapālanaṃ ||

dahaṃttam akarot kro
ḍe pāvakaṃ yad apāṃ patiḥ |
ātmānaṃ pīḍayitvāpi sādhuḥ sukhayate paraṃ ||
hlādayaty āśritān vṛkṣo duḥkhaṃ ca sahate svayaṃ ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca |

devaduṃdubhayo neduḥs tu
lām auśīnare nṛpe ||
tatas tasya tadā jñātvā vākya caitad abhāṣata ||
śakraḥ svarūpam āsthāya dharmme rājñaḥ parāṃ sthitiṃ |
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ ||

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan imaṃ
yajñam upāgatau ||
mahākaruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ tat saduḥṣkaraṃ |
naiva pūrvve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava ||

prāṇasaṃśayalubdhaiṣu na sā prāṇe
ṣu dehināṃ ||
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇī svāśrayārthārthaniṣṭurā ||
tvayy eva kevalā rājat karuṇā karuṇāpara |
svakarmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat ||

tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣoārthaṃ ba
ddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||
anāthe vikale dīne nirddhane rthini rogiṇie ||
adṛṣṭe dṛṣṭapūrve vā tulye ca karuṇaṃ tat ||
yathābhibhūya sarbāṇi jyotīṃṣy arko vatiṣṭhate ||

tathābhibhūya ka
ruṇā tava dharmmān avasthitā ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||
agatvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣa
ti |
tatparaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nāvarttate punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ ||
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hī jīvaṃti keva
lātmodaraṃbharā |
sa jīvati punaḥ ślāghyaṃ parārthaṃ yas tu jīvati ||
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||
na hi svadehaśāṃtyarthaṃ jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ |

paropakā
ravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā |
sa paraṃ padam āpnoti parād api hi yat paraṃ ||
paropakāraikadhanāḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādaśā bhuvi
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ samukṣattāni pārthiva |
eṣā te sāśvatī kīrtti lokān anu bhaviṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva bālayitvā mahīṃ ciraṃ ||

sarvā lokān atikramya bra
hmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ||
evam uktā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmunus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājānukratum iṣṭvā taṃ mumude devavat tadā ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamaṃ
vimuktaḥ || sarvapāpebhya svargalokaṃ ca gachati ||
